puzzles.text: A useful question is: what does the opponent want to do? White wants to gain space with b4-b5 followed by c5-c6. By exchanging on c5, White is forced to recapture with the b-pawn, making the above plan no longer possible. If White recaptures with the d-pawn, the Black bishop on g7 becomes very strong. Black has powerful ideas like ...Ne4.
